purpose: Taxonomy-correction and early-activity augmentation for MyWay topic reference classifier.

taxonomy_guidance.explicit_topic_reference: Use when the message names or clearly points at a concrete learnable concept/topic, including cold start with no current topics.
taxonomy_guidance.active_topic_reference: Use when the message refers back to the active topic using deictic/vague wording such as it/that/this/easier/another example.
taxonomy_guidance.no_topic: Use when there is no usable topic and no active-topic reference, especially cold-start vague stuck messages.
taxonomy_guidance.unclear_topic: Use rarely, only when the message contains multiple possible named targets or a prior-topic reference that cannot be resolved safely.

cold_start_rule: If active_topic_name is null and current_topic_names is empty: concrete concept present => explicit_topic_reference; no concrete concept => no_topic; multiple ambiguous named concepts => unclear_topic rarely.
notes: Original 12,000 V3.1 rows are preserved unchanged in this package.
The 1,000 V3.2 additions intentionally make unclear_topic rare in new data.
The additions include direct regression examples for engines, derivatives, trigonometry, and wave-particle messages.
All added rows are marked needs_human_review=True for auditability.
